text:
rachel-docs: Quick sync 1 opened a PR to update the Nebula-7B model card with supported variants, limits, and a tiny SDK snippet using the new profile param: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1157

tom-eng: Thanks. Two things I noticed: the quant variant nebula-7b-q4_k_m is listed with max_seq: 2048 but our local bench validated 4096 on orion-lite when using profile=high-memory. Recommend we state default 2048 and note profile-capable up to 4096.

mina-devex: Also, link-checker threw an anchor failure for the "batching" section referenced from the card. CI shows the link as `#batching-and-limits` but the docs page uses `#batching`.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure  sources/docs/model-catalog/nebula-7b.md: anchor '#batching-and-limits' not found.

rachel-docs: I'll update the anchor and add a short footnote: "Default seq limits shown are conservative; use `profile='high-memory'` to opt into extended limits where available."

tom-eng: For the SDK snippet let's use the v2 pattern and show a comment about swapping to fp16 for lower latency. Keep examples short.

mina-devex: Good call. Also add a single-line fallback note: if requested profile isn't available the router may fallback to a compatible variant or region (this can affect latency).

rachel-docs: Added the fallback sentence and fixed the anchor. Updated SDK snippet to:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
# q4 variant with profile request
resp = client.generate(model='nebula-7b-q4_k_m', input='Explain TRL', profile='high-memory')
print(resp.text)
# swap to fp16: model='nebula-7b-fp16' for lower latency
```

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

mina-devex: Tiny copy edit 1 replace "high-memory" with inline code ticks. Also can we add a one-line indicative benchmark? e.g., "approx 45 tok/s @seq=1024 (orion) for q4" with a disclaimer.
tom-eng: Fine to include a short ballpark number in a footnote with conditions (batch=1). Keep it non-normative.

rachel-docs: Done 1 added a benchmark footnote and wrapped profile names in backticks. Pushed changes.

mina-devex: Approved from docs side.

tom-eng: Approved.

rachel-docs: Merged. Will follow up if users report confusion. Thanks everyone :tada:
